**The document does not report HumanEval results.** No experiment in the paper evaluates on HumanEval.

- **Code benchmark used:** The only code benchmark is LiveCodeBench (p. 2, p. 13).
- **Chen et al. (2021):** This paper (HumanEval's source) is cited only for the unbiased pass@k estimator (p. 26).
- **Pass@k analysis:** It covers Naive Parallel-RL, not Adapted Parallel-RL. It uses AIME2025, GPQA Diamond, Knights & Knaves and LiveCodeBench (p. 26).

The closest available figures are Adapted Parallel-RL's LiveCodeBench accuracies with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B:

- **Full-parameter GRPO:** 22.5% (+0.9 over single-task RL) (Table 4, p. 7)
- **LoRA GRPO:** 17.3% (Table 6, p. 24)
- **Full-parameter PPO:** 19.5% (Table 6, p. 24)

These are LiveCodeBench accuracies, not HumanEval pass@1, and shouldn't be used as a substitute.
